footer.brand_desc: Authentic French expertise available for catering and franchises. Taste the difference of true craftsmanship.

hero.subtitle: Miami's Premier Crêpe Catering & Franchise Experience

welcome.p1: We are more than just a crêperie; we are an experience. Born from a passion for authentic French culinary traditions, we bring the art of crêpe-making directly to your event.
welcome.p2: Using only the finest ingredients and time-honored techniques, every crêpe is a masterpiece of flavor and texture, folded to perfection.

menu.title: The Perfect Balance
menu.subtitle: Whether you crave the sweetness of fresh fruits or the savory richness of gourmet cheese, we have a crêpe for you.

sweet.title: Sweet Crêpes
sweet.desc: Indulge in our classic combinations featuring fresh strawberries, bananas, Nutella, and unique creations like the Dubai Crepe.

savory.title: Savory Crêpes
savory.desc: Experience a full meal wrapped in a delicate batter. Featuring options like the Bacon Lovers, Cordon Bleu, and fresh Caprese.

catering.title: Bring Paris to Your Event
catering.desc: Elevate your weddings, corporate events, and private parties with our live crêpe stations. We provide a sophisticated culinary show that your guests will never forget.
